quote: Had we lived, I should have had a tale to tell of the hardihood, endurance, and courage of my companions which would have stirred the heart of every Englishman.
source: Robert Falcon Scott, Scott’s Last Expedition, vol. I, Message to the Public, closing paragraph (arr. Leonard Huxley, 1913)
note: Corrected the locator. The Message to the Public is undated; 29 March 1912 is the date of the last journal entry, not of the message, which is printed after the letters at the close of the journals in volume I. The wording is exact.
